title: Comparison harness vs aff3ct and IT++
description:
## Goal

Side-by-side comparison harness producing AWGN BLER curves for
DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM and at least one 5G NR LDPC configuration vs
aff3ct or IT++ on identical channel parameters.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR + research enablers) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Sequencing: depends on `23d3525f` (5G NR
kernel tuning). Aspirational epic deliverable from `f9717e7e` (the
research-grade story).

aff3ct is a C++ FEC simulation library (https://aff3ct.github.io/);
IT++ (http://itpp.sourceforge.net/) is an older but still-used
research library. Either suffices for an external comparison.

## Deliverables

1. Comparison harness in `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/`:
   - Driver script: `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/run.sh`
     (bash) that runs:
     - The `gf2-sim` pipeline at a fixed bracket for DVB-T2
       r1/2 16-QAM via the campaign binary.
     - aff3ct at the matching configuration via its CLI
       (assumes aff3ct is on PATH or invokes a hermetic build).
     - Both invocations use the same seed, same channel model,
       same number of frames per SNR point.
   - For 5G NR: same comparison for BG1 / Z=384 / r1/2 / BLER
     bracket.
2. CSV outputs:
   - `comparison/dvb-t2-r12-16qam-vs-aff3ct.csv` with columns:
     `es_n0_db, gf2_sim_bler, aff3ct_bler, gf2_sim_fps,
     aff3ct_fps`.
   - `comparison/nr-5g-bg1-r12-vs-aff3ct.csv` (or `vs-itpp.csv`
     depending on the chosen reference).
3. Visualisation notebook or plot script
   (`dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/plot.py`) producing
   side-by-side BLER curves (PNG).
4. README at `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/README.md`
   documenting the reference library version, invocation, host,
   and headline result (BLER agreement within ± 0.2 dB at FER
   10⁻²).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] CSV files for at least one DVB-T2 and one 5G NR
  configuration vs at least one external library (aff3ct or
  IT++) committed under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/`.
- [hard] BLER curves agree with the external library within
  ± 0.2 dB at FER 10⁻² (any larger discrepancy must be
  investigated and reported in the README before this gate
  passes).
- [hard] PNG plots committed.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- This is the [aspirational] epic deliverable; if the external
  library installation is infeasible on the available host,
  document the blocker in the README and escalate. Do not skip
  silently.
